New Accounts

Its best to curate an account to have access to all of Reddit. Many subs, especailly big ones, filter new accounts. R/funny is the most egregious one as it filters accounts for a month. Also, about half of Reddit filters negative karma accounts so it pays to build up some troll tokens to start with, i.e. - karma whore. Karma will generally buy you appoximately 3x downvotes, so +10k will be good for -30k. Also, individual subs will slap a timer on ur ass if you have negative comment karma in those subs.

 

Characters

Most trolls develop a character. While there is nothing inherently wrong with the "whatever gets it done" / free trolling approach, its not paticularly good for either masking your intentions or developing a fan base. A couple examples of popular character trolls would be: Sal_Bundry_5TDs1Game (Married With Children parody) or Incites (narcissistic valley girl). And of course the internets most famous troll, Ken M (well meaning but oblivious retiree).

Reddit allows for customization of profiles and its highly advisable to make use of it. This should reflect and be consistent with the character, including username/ images/ and posts. Pinning a text post can be a fun way of interacting with followers.

 

Finding Spots

Locating posts:

1) posts with at least 200 upvotes / hour. More is obviously better.

2) between 1-4 hrs old is ideal

3) LESS than 100 comments. Troll comments will get buried after the post hits 200 comments.

Locating comments:

1) top 3 comments chains.

2) no children (as in dont share spots). Getting buried may happen later but no need to hinder a troll right from go.

2) 2nd to 4th in the chain is ideal. Dont bother making top level comments as theyll be buried to fuck.

3) at least a third of an upvote / minute. Again, more is obviously better.

 

Content / TOS

Reddit admins and mods have really cracked down on what they consider permissible content. Anything approaching pedophilia, even the most obvious joke, is almost a guaranteed admin suspension. Racism and homophobia, pejoratives like n!gger and f@ggot, no matter how obvious the joke, can also get you there. And of course anything they would consider violent content. The bottom line is that admins will not consider context when considering a suspension.

Personal attacks are a pet peeve of most mods. You can avoid this with little tricks of language. For instance: instead of saying, "you are dumb" say "I think that idea is dumb"...little differences like that. Ad-hominem is low effort, anyway.

There are endless techniques to raking in downvotes, be it with long meandering essays to simply the letter 'K' and everything in between. It would be exhaustive to try and list. But there are a number of subs to get x-posted to and if your comments can fit into one or preferably more of these then you are on the right track:

iamverysmart, iamverybadass, ihavesex, cringepics, thathappened, nobodyasked, subredditdrama, drama, shitamericanssay, niceguys, trashy, copypasta, emojipasta, cursedcomments, whooosh, etc... Bonus troll cred for getting posted.
